missed.why:
A family P2 did not consider: the I2C (Inter-Integrated Circuit) counterpart of the rank-1 ADS1220. It fills P2's free third slot. It meets every requirement value of the function.
(1) Accuracy (V235, ±2 °C): ±1.67 °C over 0 to 200 °C at 0 to 50 °C board ambient, with a firmware offset calibration before each reading. The calibration uses mux setting 1110, which shorts AINP and AINN to (AVDD + AVSS)/2 (Register 0 table, section 8.3). Settings are gain 32 and the internal 2.048 V reference. The budget, from the Electrical Characteristics of SBAS751B:
- cold-junction sensor ±1.0 °C max at TA 0 to 85 °C;
- gain error ±0.05 % max at 25 °C (gain 1 to 32), plus 2 ppm/°C max × 25 °C;
- reference ±0.15 % max at 25 °C (TSSOP), plus 30 ppm/°C max × 25 °C.
Gain and reference together give ±0.28 % of 8.138 mV = ±22.8 µV = ±0.57 °C at 40.1 µV/°C. INL (integral nonlinearity) is ±15 ppm of the 128 mV FSR (full-scale range) = ±1.9 µV = ±0.05 °C. The sensor's supply sensitivity is 0.25 °C/V max × 0.1 V = ±0.03 °C. Noise at gain 32 and 20 SPS is 0.24 µVrms (Equation 10). The firmware NIST conversion error is not counted. Without the calibration the budget is not shown: offset at gain 2 to 128 is ±4 µV typical only.
(2) Open thermocouple (V250): 10 µA burn-out current sources (BCS bit, Register 2 bit 3). Section 9.2.1.2 shows 1 to 50 MΩ bias resistors that drive an open lead to full scale.
(3) The other values: 20 SPS, so a reading well inside 2,000 ms (V236). Type K through the firmware NIST conversion (V233). AVDD 2.3 to 5.5 V and DVDD 3.3 V. SDA and SCL tolerate 7 V, and DRDY swings to DVDD, so logic is 3.3 V. Analog input absolute maximum is AVSS − 0.3 V to AVDD + 0.3 V, so round 2 protection carries the 67.2 V (V237).
(4) Address, for P5: I2C Standard, Fast and Fast-mode Plus. Table 14 sets the address to 0x40 to 0x4F from A0 and A1. That range is the port monitors' and INA238s' range, so on the internal bus the part needs a free address at 0x46 or above.
(5) Sourcing: JLCPCB stockCount 4,147, canPresaleNumber 4,022, expand, US$7.9694 at quantity 1 (vendors.py jlcpcb C2872338, 2026-09-29T03:09:49Z). ADS122C04IRTER (C2670105): 203 and 134 (03:09:50Z). Digi-Key ADS122C04IPWR: Active, 2,585, lead 16 weeks (vendors.py digikey, 03:10:11Z... read at 03:10:09Z). TI product page https://www.ti.com/product/ADS122C04: TSSOP (PW) marketingStatusDescription ACTIVE (03:10:18Z). ADS112C04IPWR: JLCPCB 2,146 and 2,139 (03:09:50Z); Digi-Key Active, 2,247, lead 16 weeks (03:10:11Z).
(6) Siblings that fail: ADS1120IPWR (C84284), which T4's P3 named. Its temperature sensor accuracy is ±0.25 °C and ±0.5 °C typical only, with no maximum (SBAS535D, revised June 2026, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ads1120.pdf, read 03:07:07Z), so its cold-junction error is not shown. Also failing, each for a typical-only figure: MCP3421 (gain drift and PGA gain match typical only, DS22003E read 03:09:26Z) and AD7124-4 (temperature sensor ±0.5 °C in the typical column, read 03:09:34Z).

missed.why:
An S1 EEPROM family P2 did not consider. Like M24256E, its endurance is stated at 85 °C.
(1) Memory Cell Characteristics, Min column: 4,000,000 writes at Ta 25 °C and 1,200,000 at 85 °C. A write cycle counts per 4-byte unit (Note 17).
(2) Capacity 16,384 bytes against 792 (V247). With P2's method (a 396-byte record in 7 pages of 64 bytes, rotated over the array), 36 slots × 1,200,000 = 43,200,000 saves against 3,200,000 (V248).
(3) Supply 1.7 to 5.5 V; ambient −40 to +125 °C; 1 MHz; write cycle 3.5 ms max.
(4) Device code 1010 with A2, A1 and A0, so it sits at 0x50 to 0x57, outside 0x40 to 0x4F.
(5) Stock: JLCPCB stockCount 100, canPresaleNumber 100 (vendors.py jlcpcb C6132320, 03:13:55Z), which passes the gate of 50. Digi-Key: Active, stock 0, lead 15 weeks (vendors.py digikey BR24H128FVT-5ACE2, 03:14:24Z). No rule-5 route through Digi-Key. A pin-compatible alternate was not checked.
(6) ROHM's product-page status was not read: the page URLs tried returned 404 (03:13:29Z, 03:13:38Z).
(7) It ranks below M24256E: half the capacity and far less stock. BR24G512FJ-5AE2 (C29652163) held 36 and 36 at JLCPCB (03:13:59Z), under the gate.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: no open-thermocouple detection: DS20005426F gives open- and short-circuit detection through VSENSE to the MCP9601/L01/RL01 only; misses V250 (yes)
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails:
DS20005426F (https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/en/DeviceDoc/MCP960X-L0X-RL0X-Data-Sheet-20005426F.pdf, read 2026-09-29T03:14:47Z) gives open detection for the MCP9600/L00/RL00 too.
(1) Section 6.3.3.1 (Open-Circuit Detection Technique) and Figure 6-6 add RB = 1 MΩ bias resistors. With the thermocouple open, VIN+ sits at 0.66 × VDD and VIN− at VSS. That sets bit 4 (Input Range) of the STATUS register (Register 5-6). The section states 'The passive circuit does not affect the MCP9600/L00/RL00 accuracy'. V250 is met with three resistors, as the rank-1 ADS1220 meets it with its burn-out sources.
(2) Accuracy: TH hot-junction ±1.5 °C max at TA 0 to +85 °C and VDD 3.3 V, with TH = TC + TΔ, so the cold junction is included. That meets V235's ±2 °C on chip. The MCP96L00T-E/MX stays dropped: ±4.0 °C max, and 12 in the 2026-09-14 copy.
(3) Other values: address 0x60 to 0x67 (1100 xxx). fSCL 10 to 100 kHz, as the MCP9601. tCONV 320 ms typical at 18 bits. VDD 2.7 to 5.5 V. Pins rated GND − 0.3 V to 6.0 V.
(4) Silicon revision caveat: Register 5-6 refers to errata DS80000741 for the date codes with this feature. DS80000741B (https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/en/DeviceDoc/80000741B.pdf, read 03:15:49Z) fixes the TH accuracy issue from date code 1723, Device ID/Revision 0x4012 at register 0x20. It does not name the Input Range bit, so firmware checks register 0x20.
(5) Sourcing: JLCPCB C220851 stockCount 2,731, canPresaleNumber 2,700, US$9.9171 at quantity 1 (03:15:17Z). C623918: 99 and 96 (03:15:18Z). Digi-Key MCP9600-E/MX: Active, 812, lead 20 weeks (03:15:20Z). MCP9600T-E/MX: Active, 3,109, lead 20 weeks (03:15:22Z). Microchip product page https://www.microchip.com/en-us/product/MCP9600: 'Status: In Production' (03:16:35Z). It clears the gate with far more stock than P2's rank-2 MCP9601-E/MX (JLCPCB 72 and 67 at 03:09:49Z). Pin-for-pin fit with the MCP9601 was not checked.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: accuracy (V235, ±2 °C) not shown: 'Full-Scale and INL Error' ±0.15 %FS at TA −20 to +85 °C read against the ±78.125 mV full scale of the type K range gives up to ±3.95 °C at 200 °C
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails:
The reading holds only for the built-in type K mode at gain 8. The datasheet also offers voltage mode at gain 32. Configuration 1 TC type 11xx gives 'Voltage Mode, Gain = 32', and section 'Using Unsupported Thermocouple Types' gives a ±19.531 mV full scale. That page says: 'Use the voltage data and the cold-junction temperature to calculate the thermocouple's hot-junction temperature'.
(1) %FS is taken against the full scale of the gain in use. Note 7 and the µV rows show it: input offset ±0.015 %FS equals ±11.7 µV at gain 8 and ±2.9 µV at gain 32, which is 0.015 % of 78.125 mV and of 19.531 mV.
(2) Type K over 0 to 200 °C, with the cold junction at 0 to 50 °C, spans −2.02 to +8.14 mV. That fits ±19.531 mV.
(3) Budget from the Electrical Characteristics at TA −20 to +85 °C, with firmware doing the NIST conversion as it does for the ADS1220:
- Full-Scale and INL ±0.15 % × 19.531 mV = ±29.3 µV = ±0.74 °C at 39.5 µV/°C;
- input offset ±2.9 µV = ±0.07 °C;
- cold-junction error ±0.7 °C.
The sum is ±1.51 °C against ±2 °C, before the firmware's conversion error, which depends on its table and is not counted.
(4) Open-circuit detection (OCFAULT bits, Table 4) and the cold-junction reading are independent of the TC type setting. Note 6 holds the specification to VBIAS common mode, so BIAS is wired as the datasheet shows.
(5) Sources: datasheet 19-7534 Rev 0 (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/MAX31856.pdf, vendors.py fetch --client safari, read 2026-09-29T03:08:28Z), pages 3 to 5 and 28 to 29. JLCPCB C2653162 stockCount 11,459, canPresaleNumber 11,205, US$4.3307 at quantity 1 (03:09:50Z). C116632: 126 and 97 (03:09:50Z). Digi-Key MAX31856MUD+T: ProductStatus Active, 12,023, lead 27 weeks. That answer came back cached: true, first read 2026-09-29T02:47:35Z. It is the status of record for an Analog Devices part under the Lifecycle check.
